concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-upi-api-only]] — 2022-modified, 2026-09-15-captured India UPI API-only guide for INR Intent app redirects, QR display and legacy Collect VPA, with November 2025 new-merchant Collect cutoff, conditional validation and webhook-final outcomes; TEST checklist event spelling conflicts with webhook tables.
warnings: November 2025 Collect policy appears in the body despite 2022 last_modified metadata; retain both dates rather than treating metadata as freshness proof.
TEST simulator checklists say eventCode AUTHORISED, while all flow outcome tables say AUTHORISATION.
Five-minute timers are recommendations/reminders, not documented payment expiry.
Collect VPA validation is optional, connection-limited and cannot prove subsequent debit success.
